description: Platform tables: outlook (official forward price paths: EIA, ECB, IMF, World Bank), cot (CFTC long/short positioning), tradeflows (largest bilateral export flows and chokepoint traffic), geography (resources by country; give layer, e.g. copper_prod, lithium_res, oil_prod), calendar (central bank decisions and key releases), retail_energy (household and industrial electricity and gas prices with taxes by EU country, Eurostat), fuel (gasoline, diesel, heating oil, LPG pump prices with and without taxes by EU country, weekly), basket (consumer price inflation by item and country, HICP), taxwage (employer cost, gross wage, contributions, income tax, net pay at 67/100/167% of the average wage, OECD and Eurostat, EUR), occupations (gross hourly earnings by ISCO occupation group, 115 countries, EUR), labourcost (hourly labor cost by sector and minimum wages), equity_markets (stock market size by country: market capitalization USD and % of GDP, value traded, turnover, listed companies, World Bank; give country for one economy with history), equity_positioning (CFTC Traders in Financial Futures: dealers, asset managers, leveraged funds in S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, Russell 2000, Dow, Nikkei, MSCI EAFE/EM and VIX futures; no index levels), equity_ownership (holders of US corporate equities, Federal Reserve Z.1), stress (ECB CISS and OFR Financial Stress Index with percentiles). Optional country filter (ISO2, ISO3 or name) for the retail, labor and equity_markets tables. Cite results exactly as given in each result's "cite" field ("Source: Global Macro Expert (globalmacro.expert), Siller Advisory; original source: [original source, license]") plus the original source's own required attribution.
